note: Documents shorter than the two byte gzip magic that the reader peeks for before it does anything else. A short read is not an error: such a document cannot be gzip, so it falls through to the plain stream path and is treated as an ordinary unsigned document. Also covers a gzip header that is present but truncated, which is an error.

cases.name: Inspect Empty Input
cases.note: An empty document is a valid unsigned document, so there is nothing to report and nothing to fail on.

cases.name: Verify Empty Input
cases.note: Valid, but it carries no signature for the key to match.

cases.name: Sign Empty Input
cases.note: An empty body still gets a hash header and a signature over it.

cases.name: Verify Signed Empty Input
cases.note: Signing then verifying an empty document round trips back to nothing, which is the point: the short input path is not a special case, it is the plain path.

cases.name: Verify Truncated Gzip
cases.note: The magic is there but the stream is cut short, so this is a real failure rather than a plain document.
